summary: Four studies directly apply Bayesian hierarchical (multilevel probabilistic) models with partial pooling to the early prediction of septic deterioration. The most recent and highest‑performing work is Gupta et al. (2024) [V0019], which reports an accuracy of 0.83 on the LedgerGuard ICU dataset. Fischer et al. (2023) [V0018] achieves an F1 score of 0.76 on AgriSat‑4, while El‑Sayed et al. (2022) [V0017] reports an AUROC of 0.69 on Atlas‑ICU. Haddad et al. (2025) [V0020] evaluates the same modelling approach on CellLife and obtains a mean absolute error (MAE) of 0.9. No other candidate in the supplied list applies Bayesian hierarchical models to sepsis prediction.

claims.value: Bayesian hierarchical (multilevel probabilistic) models with partial pooling
